description:
FILED s464 (Fable, 2026-09-02) on a USER instruction: "make a plan for how to go over these
ignored tests, crashing files etc and review them carefully.  Present the plan to me next
session, after this standard subs behaving as :lvalue is fixed" (= after #964 merges).

THE PLAN IS docs/plan-test-audit-s464.md (DRAFT).  Before presenting: re-measure its §2
inventory on the merged #964 tree (the companion snapshot moves by op/sub.t at least; the
sweep TOTAL may move) and fill in the two unknowns (op/taint.t row count; the quarantined
pair).  Then ask the five §5 decisions and record the answers in DECIDED.

WHY (the USER's worry, measured): #964's test existed TWICE and was neutralised both times
-- perl-tests/sub.t's [perl #91844] shift row replaced by an inline ok(1,'SKIP: @_ aliasing
not supported') on 2026-05-19 (fddd67b) with a WRONG diagnosis, and the real suite's
op/sub.t row blessed inside the COUNT 53/12.  The inventory (main a8b4043): companion --
2 quarantined since 2026-08-02, 8 hang-set + 3 slow files only in full runs (last found
s398 2026-08-15), 10 TRANSPILE-FAIL files producing ZERO rows every run (~2,030 perl rows:
op/coresubs.t 1109, op/lvref.t 199, op/svleak.t 156, op/for.t 148, op/goto.t 132, base/lex.t
120, run/runenv.t 106, re/reg_eval_scope.t 48, comp/our.t 7, op/taint.t), 273 DIFF files with
53,619 failing rows blessed as COUNTS (no per-row list), 111 XDIFF; sweep -- 132 inline
ok(1,SKIP) rows in 11 files (#965), 695 blessed fails with NO cause column, 14 PARTIAL files
(~400 rows past the abort), state.t 158 rows lost whole since s415 to the given/when
refusal, OK files with plan >> produced (lc.t 82 of 2,659; pack.t 5,725 of 14,722), and 43 of
105 extracted files differ from perl 5.40.3's t/ (while.t = a 4-test file vs 223 lines).

INSTRUMENTS FIRST (§3): I1 row-level blessing for the companion suite; I2 planned-minus-
produced as a blessed column in both runners; I3 a cause column in fail-baseline.tsv;
I4 a full --all companion once per ROUND.  Phases (§4): 0 instruments -> 1 zero-row files
-> 2 aborting files -> 3 blessed rows read for cause (budgeted) -> 4 #965 + perl-tests
refresh -> 5 hang set / quarantine / XDIFF re-read.  Sizing in the doc.


PHASE 0 DONE (s465az, Opus; REVIEWED + MERGED s466 Fable, main 57848f3): I1 baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv (21,097 rows / 267 files), I2 baselines/row-shortfall.tsv (459,454 rows / 260 files: 376,788 caused, 82,666 UNEXPLAINED in 183 files = THE QUEUE; the s465az report said 86,126/185 -- recounted from the blessed file), I3 fail-baseline.tsv column 6 (484 rows post-#1028: 331 caused, 153 cause-less), I4 baselines/perl-suite-notrun-stamps.tsv (13 files, 2 NEVER).  Readers: runbook 4c-4f; tests tools/t/audit-instruments.t.  CLAUDE.md I4 cadence line written s466.  Review fixes s466: four stale `+skip` definition comments, one UNEXPLAINED predicate.  NEXT = phases 1-5 (plan-test-audit-s464.md section 4), interleaved as the standing audit slot (USER s465).
